payload.claim: Change the view if (a) North American comparable sales stop deteriorating — a sequential improvement from -9% toward flat in Q3/Q4 FY2026 with full-price sell-through recovering above 80%, alongside guidance that is reaffirmed or raised rather than cut a third time; or (b) the new CEO's first full merchandise assortment ships and gross margin stabilises above 56% without the one-off tariff refund, restoring positive operating leverage; or (c) fair value re-computes materially above spot because the marked-down base year proves too pessimistic. Cut the view if a third consecutive guidance cut lands, if EBIT margin drops below 14% on a TTM basis, or if the integrity gate escalates from Flag to Disqualifying on the pending SDNY inventory/disclosure case (accounting channel) — the greenwashing matters alone do not touch the price.

prediction.reasoning: FY2026 guidance of $10.35–10.50B revenue and $9.48–$9.73 EPS backs into roughly 15% EBIT margin even *including* the one-off $134.5M tariff refund, versus 17.84% on the current TTM and 19.9% in FY2026 — discounting into a -10% Q3 plus fixed-cost deleverage compounds it. This is where I depart from the price: the reverse DCF's 3.9% growth assumes the margin structure holds while the company is telling us operating leverage has already inverted.
